I replied to Marcus in a thread in #north-random. I noted that the signed order form deadline for Thornbury Cloth Co. is 15 August, as their ops lead corrected.

I also pointed out that 15 August has already passed, since today is 14 October, and asked him to tell me if he meant a later date.

I took no other action. This is an operational date, not a finance figure, so it can be shared in the channel.
